_note: Changes That Never Clash: bare previs of the scholars' coast libraries (set 'libraries', whose reading rooms hold the loan desk, its pebble board and, beside it, a stepped stand of the other scholars' boards; art/sets/libraries.json gives each desk and board) and the courier landing at the southern tip (set 'landing', baked into the island). Exterior shots use the baked island and no set. No cast: the image pass adds the people; each note is the picture's brief. The scholar is the one figure in grey (art/world-prompt.md §3.5, ref paxos/scholar); librarians wear long cream chitons. cover/scene.png is still the earlier terrace scene, kept only so the cover cards on the home page and the setting page (served from R2) match it in art/web/images.py until a new cover scene replaces it.

cover.note: The loan desk of a library on the coast: the marble pebble board on the desk in the foreground, white pebbles in three grooves and black in three, and beyond it, on a stepped stand beside the desk, the boards the desk keeps for other scholars, each with a wax tag of its own colour; the rack of scrolls behind. The visiting scholar in grey stands before the desk at the left edge of the frame, by the bowls, with a scroll just lent, clear of the board and the stand; the librarian behind the desk sets one white pebble in the library's own groove.

scene.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC, inside a small library. Keep [image 1]'s camera, framing and layout exactly. The room is a finished model: keep every modelled wall, floor slab, shelf, scroll, desk, stand, board, stool, bowl, tag and pebble exactly where it is, give each its real material, add nothing. Soft daylight from the open door. On the desk a white marble board with shallow grooves; white pebbles in the three grooves on the left, black in the three on the right. Beside the desk a stepped timber stand holds five smaller marble boards, one to a step, each with its own white and black pebbles and a wax tag of its own colour on its front edge, as modelled: the scholar's board on the desk is one of several. A scholar in a short grey chiton like [image 2]'s man stands before the desk at the left edge of the frame, by the bowls, clear of the board and the stand; behind the desk a librarian in a long cream chiton sets one white pebble in a groove. Exactly two people. No writing.

p01-coast.note: The west shore of the scholars' coast from the sea with a long lens and a level horizon: three libraries apart from one another above the rocky coves, olive and pine between them, the sea in front. A courier's boat rounds the point towards the next library.
